mainEntity.name: Does this page mean the site is perfectly accessible in every context?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. It means accessibility is being treated as an active control area with ongoing improvement.

mainEntity.name: What should I include in an accessibility report?

acceptedAnswer.text: The page or section, the issue, the task you were trying to complete, and any relevant device or assistive-technology context.

mainEntity.name: Can I contact you if a barrier stops me from finishing a form or booking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Where reasonably possible, we will provide an alternative route so the issue does not block access to an essential step.
